objections: Google: Incorrectly defines a non-state actor strictly as a human rights violator rather than any non-governmental entity.

NVIDIA: Hindi meaning "सरकार से बाहर का मानवाधिकार उल्लंघनकर्ता" is inaccurate; in law, "non-state actor" broadly refers to any non-state entity (corporations, NGOs, etc.), not specifically a rights violator.
